Empire / White Monolith sacred-tech architecture, sterile symmetric geometry, intentional Ma emptiness, monumental scale, figure dwarfed but central.

COMPOSITION: wide cinematic 2.35:1 anamorphic frame (NOT square, NOT portrait), centered frontal three-quarter, vertical axis through the figure, premium quiet luxury rendering, hyper-real matte ceramic material detail.
